hooks.command: FILE="$(cat | jq -r '.tool_input.file_path')"; case "$FILE" in *.rs) cargo.exe check -p sim 2>&1 ;; esac
FILE="$(cat | jq -r '.tool_input.file_path')"; case "$FILE" in *.rs) cargo.exe clippy 2>&1 ;; esac
FILE="$(cat | jq -r '.tool_input.file_path')"; case "$FILE" in *.cs) dotnet.exe build client/skock.csproj 2>&1 ;; esac
FILE="$(cat | jq -r '.tool_input.file_path')"; case "$FILE" in *.cs) dotnet.exe test client.tests/skock.tests.csproj 2>&1 ;; esac
FILE="$(cat | jq -r '.tool_input.file_path')"; case "$FILE" in *.cs) roslynator.exe analyze client/skock.csproj 2>&1 ;; esac
